snippet.title: Daisy Dangerous - Pre-Alpha Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Daisy Dangerous is action platformer where the main character has limited resources to handle a set of robot-overrun, trap-infested stages.

Get the pre-alpha demo here: https://securas.itch.io/daisydangerous
